title_en: Poem for Parashat Genesis First Kedusha (Ve'atta Qadosh)
title_he: פיוט לפרשת בראשית קדושה ראשונה (ואתה קדוש)

content.hebrew: אַתָּה אֵל לְכֹל רֹאשׁ מִתְנַשֵּׂא,
content.english: You are God, who are elevated as head above all,

content.hebrew: כִּי מָעוֹן נִמְצֵֽאתָ לַכֹּל, וּמַחְסֶה.
content.english: For You are found to be a home by all, and a refuge.

content.hebrew: שַֽׂמְתָּ חֶבְיוֹן עֻזְּךָ הַכִּסֵּא,
content.english: You placed the Throne as the hiding place of Your strength—

content.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר נִסְתַּֽרְתָּ שָׁם בְּיוֹם הַמַּעֲשֶׂה. (שמואל א כ:יט)
content.english: Where You hid on the day of action. (1 Sam. 20:19)

content.hebrew: הֵכִין מְאוֹרוֹת לִמְשֹׁל בַּיּוֹם וּבַלַּֽיְלָה,
content.english: He established the luminaries to rule over the day and the night;

content.hebrew: בַּגָּדוֹל הֵחֵל וּבַקָּטוֹן כִּלָּה.
content.english: He began with the greater one, and finished with the smaller.

content.hebrew: קֶֽדֶם וְאָחוֹר מִי יַחְקֹר וּמִי יְמַלְּלָהּ?
content.transliteration: Ḳedem ve’aḥor, mi yaḥḳor umi yemallela?
content.english: Who can investigate or speak of [existence] before or after,

content.hebrew: הַעְמֵק שְׁאָֽלָה אוֹ הַגְבֵּֽהַּ לְמָֽעְלָה. (ישעיהו ז:יא)
content.english: To ask about the deep, or ascend high above? (Isa. 7:11)

content.hebrew: רָצָה בְטוּבוֹ לִבְרוֹא אָדָם, זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה, וּלְכַבְּדָם,
content.transliteration: Ratsa betuvo livro adam, zachar unḳeva, ulchabbedam:
content.english: It pleased Him, in His goodness, to create and show honor to humanity, male and female,

content.hebrew: וְכֹל שָׁת תַּֽחַת יָדָם.
content.english: And He placed everything in their hands.

content.hebrew: וְהֵם עָבְרוּ מִצְוָתוֹ – וְזֶה פִידָם וְאֵידָם:
content.english: [But] they violated His commandment, and this was their destruction and downfall—

content.hebrew: וַיְגָֽרֶשׁ אֶת־הָאָדָם. (בראשית ג:כד)
content.english: [That] He expelled Adam. (Gen. 3:24)

content.hebrew: נְוֵה הַשְּׂרָפִים יְהִי גַן עֵֽדֶן לְמַעֲרֶֽכֶת,
content.english: The Garden of Eden would [henceforth] be the dwelling place of the seraphim, where they would assemble,

content.hebrew: כִּי מַעֲלָתָם מֵהוֹד אֶל הוֹד נִמְשֶֽׁכֶת.
content.transliteration: Ki ma‘alatam, mehod el hod nimshechet.
content.english: For their loftiness extends from splendor to splendor.

content.hebrew: שָׁם יַשְׁכִּין גְּזֵרָה לְעַצְמָהּ נִסְמֶֽכֶת:
content.english: There He has emplaced a self-enforcing restriction:

content.hebrew: הַכְּרוּבִים וְאֵת לַֽהַט הַחֶֽרֶב הַמִּתְהַפֶּֽכֶת. (המשך הפסוק שם)
content.english: The cherubim, and the blade of the rotating sword. (ibid., cont.)

content.hebrew: נֶאְדָּר בְּרִבְבוֹת קֹֽדֶשׁ תַּרְשִׁישִׁים,
content.english: [God is] glorified amidst the holy myriads—the tarshishim,

content.hebrew: אִישׁ אִישׁ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ לְהַקְדִּישׁוֹ דֹרְשִׁים
content.english: Each one from its place seeks to declare His holiness.

content.hebrew: אֹהֲבָיו וּקְרוֹבָיו, וְלֹא יָדְעוּ נְתִיבָיו, הוֹדוֹ מְבַקְשִׁים.
content.transliteration: Ohavav uḳrovav velo yade‘u netivav, hodo mevaḳshim.
content.english: Those who love Him and are close to Him, but do not know His paths, search for His splendor.

content.hebrew: אֵל נַעֲרָץ בְּסוֹד קְדֹשִׁים. (תהלים פט:ח)
content.english: God, declared formidable by the council of the holy. (Ps. 89:8)

content.hebrew: אֵ֣ל נַֽ֭עֲרָ֖ץ בְּסֽוֹד־קְדשִׁ֣ים רַבָּ֑ה וְ֝נוֹרָ֗א עַל־כָּל־סְבִיבָֽיו׃ (תהלים פט:ח) יו֤י אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צְבָא֗וֹת מִֽי־כָמ֖וֹךָ חֲסִ֥ין ׀ יָ֑הּ וֶ֝אֱמ֥וּנָֽתְךָ֗ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃ (תהלים פט:ט) אֵֽין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיו֖י כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ (שמואל א ב:ב)
content.transliteration: El na‘arats besod ḳedoshim rabba, venora ‘al kol sevivav: Adonai, elohé tseva’ot mi chamocha ḥasin, yah, ve’emunatecha sevivotecha: En ḳadosh kadonai ki en biltecha, ve’en tsur kelohenu:
content.english: God, declared formidable by the great council of the holy, and awesome over all His surroundings. (Ps. 89:8) Adonai, God of Hosts, who is like You, O mighty one, Yah? And Your faithfulness is upon Your surroundings. (Ps. 89:9) There is none holy like Adonai, for there is none but You; and there is no rock like our God. (1 Sam. 2:2)

content.hebrew: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ (תהלים כב:ד)
content.english: And You are Holy, enthroned on Israel’s praises. (Ps. 22:4)
